reply_text:
I've replied to Pree in your DM with both tickets.

- **Driver SMS prompt glitch on overflow lots is ticket #4412.** It's in a public Central handoffs note from 2 Jan 2026. Hollis flagged it as a minor glitch with combine trailers staged on unpaved overflow lots, before Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. The same note lists #4409, a report timeout at Salina North. I found nothing later on whether #4412 was fixed.
- **West yard Door 2 double-booking is ticket #8841.** Tobias posted it in #central-random, which Pree is in, on 13 Oct 2026. Flatbeds that check in early at the kiosk get double-booked, and he flagged it to support. Nothing has been posted since.

I told her to check one thing before filing #8841: that thread calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. The handoff note also doesn't say who took the account over. So she should confirm with Tobias that #8841 really belongs to Marrow Fieldworks.

I only used sources Pree can already see: the public note, #central-random and #central-team. No finance figures or anything from other people's DMs went into the reply.
